Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Ed Keating <edjk19@comcast.net>
Sent: Tuesday, April 7, 2020 11:26 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Greatest living Tiger 
 
Mr Fenech,
On this saddest of days for all Tiger fans it occurs to me with Mr Kaline’s passing there is a vacancy for the title of “Greatest Living Tiger”.
Please accept my nomination of Alan Trammel.
I fully realize you are not the judge nor the jury for this process however you certainly can and should be a superb starting point
Stay safe and take good care
Ed Keating
